verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine, and such an engine could plausibly serve speech-recognition models or offer a real-time transcription endpoint, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions audio input, speech-to-text, transcription models, or dictation. Streaming outputs and the OpenAI-compatible API concern text generation, not transcription.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
